DriverReports.description: One thing a Driver reported from the road, with what became of it (P12). The Driver app owns nothing of the TMS's: it keeps a report only until the Driver reports Logic App tells it the TMS recorded it, refused it, or was never reached (ADR 0016).

columns.EventId: The Driver app event ID the report travels under, which the TMS keeps as the source event of the Tracking event or Proof of delivery.
columns.CorrelationId: Message trail of the Driver's action. A Deliver sends two reports (Delivered and Proof of delivery) under one.
columns.DriverId: The Driver who reported: their Driver ID (`DRV-0001`) from the token, never from the request (ADR 0037).
columns.FailureCode: The TMS's failure code of a refusal, or the integration layer's code of a report that wasn't recorded; null otherwise.
columns.Message: The readable message of a refusal, or the technical cause of a report that wasn't recorded.
columns.OutcomeAt: When the Driver reports Logic App told the Driver app the outcome; null while Sending.
columns.Remark: What the Driver said: required for a failure or damage, and the reservations of a Delivered with reservations.
columns.ShipmentNumber: The Shipment a Stop report is about (a logical reference to the TMS); null for a Start Trip or End Trip.
columns.State: `Sending` (published, not yet reported by the Logic App), `Recorded`, `Refused` or `NotRecorded` (the Logic App gave up after its retries).
columns.Stop: Which Stop of the Shipment: collection or delivery; null for a Start Trip or End Trip.
columns.TripNumber: The Trip the report is about (a logical reference to the TMS).
columns.VersionHeld: The version of the Trip the Driver app held when the Driver reported, for tracing.

DriverTrips.description: The latest version of a Trip the TMS dispatched to a Driver, as the Trip dispatch Logic App sent it (P11, ADR 0015). The Driver app takes whole versions: a lower or repeated version is acknowledged and ignored. The TMS owns the Trip (ADR 0002); this is the Driver's copy to work from.

columns.TripNumber: The Trip's number (a logical reference to the TMS).
columns.Details: The Trip version as JSON: day, planned start and driving duration, the Vehicle, and the Stops in order with their addresses, windows, Consignee and goods lines.
columns.DriverId: The Driver the Trip is dispatched to (`DRV-0001`). The ERP owns Drivers (ADR 0014).
columns.Version: The version held; only a higher one replaces it.

OutboxMessages.description: Driver app events the Driver app raised in the same transaction as the report that caused them, waiting to be published to the `driver-app-events` topic (transactional outbox, ADR 0003). They are published in order per Trip (ADR 0016).

columns.ApplicationProperties: The Service Bus application properties of the message, as JSON.
columns.CorrelationId: The Message trail the event belongs to.
columns.EventId: The event's own ID, unique, equal to the report's event ID.
columns.PublishedAt: When the publisher sent it to Service Bus; null while it waits.
columns.SessionId: The Service Bus session the message goes in: the Trip number, which keeps one Trip's events in order.
columns.Topic: The Service Bus topic it goes to.
columns.TraceParent: W3C trace context of the call that raised it, so the publish continues the same trace; null when there was none.
